Grass is useful for GamCryp because the honest answer is: ROI unavailable.

The project has points-based rewards, but GamCryp does not convert points into financial ROI unless there is a reproducible exit route.

That is the point of the model: no fake zero, no made-up yield.
awaiting_human_approval.risk_caveat: Grass points are not modeled as financial ROI unless a lawful, reproducible value route exists.

publishable.final_copy:
GamCryp ranks strategies, not hype.

A high modeled ROI can still carry high risk. A low-cost opportunity can still have weak economics. And if rewards are not reproducible, ROI stays unavailable.

The goal is decision clarity, not a recommendation.
